entities.summary: Gonzalez Germán Germen Figao is a Dominican former professional baseball pitcher. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the New York Mets, Chicago Cubs, and Colorado Rockies, and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Orix Buffaloes.
